pages.title: The Call
pages.text: The nexuses hum at night now. Not the hum of work. A $(thing)call$(), rising from the void that runs in them.$(br2)I have stopped pretending I do not hear it.

pages.title: A Warning
pages.text: Whoever reads this, do not mistake the void for a tool. It is older than our world, and it wants nothing we could understand.$(br2)Every rift I opened, something looked back through.

pages.title: The Window
pages.text: Last night the rift above a core did not close. Through it I saw another place. A $(thing)citadel$(), adrift in the void, turning slowly with no ground beneath it and no sky above.

pages.title: Its Laws
pages.text: Over there, nothing holds. Time does not run, it pools. Distance folds back on itself. A cause forgets its effect.$(br2)The logic of our world does not reach that far, and I do not know what mine will become without it.

pages.title: The Crossing
pages.text: The citadel is waiting, for something or someone. A challenge, perhaps.$(br2)I do not know where it leads, nor when I will come back.$(br2)If I come back.

pages.title: To You
pages.text: If you can enter too, and you find me, I hope you will help me grow.$(br2)If instead you find that I have gone mad, end me. But carry on my research.

pages.title: The Last Page
pages.text: The rest of this journal is blank.$(br2)Fill it.
